name: task-pingpong
algorithm: two tasks (Go: goroutines; Rust and C: threads, their std has no task runtime) pass a value back and forth over two rendezvous channels; each of n rounds sends i, the partner answers i*3+1; sum = 31 sum + each answer, wrapping (tests/bench-lanes/rt-io2/README.md).

skip.zig: not written in M6 session 5 of rt-io2: std.Thread with std.Thread.ResetEvent is the baseline to add (std/sys/STATUS.md)

notes: Written by rt-io2 (std/sys/STATUS.md, M6 session 5) so std.task's park and wake path (WaitWord through Io.wait, Chan's rendezvous) has a cross-language ratio: Mk and Go switch user-level tasks, Rust and C block OS threads (WaitOnAddress on Windows, the futex on Linux).
